title: OINK page front matter

annotation.description: Page provenance / revision block at the end of a page. Front matter `annotation: false` turns it off for one page. Its upstream attribution line is driven by front matter (`upstream_link` plus `upstream_name`, `upstream_copyright`, `upstream_license`, `upstream_notice`); the theme declares no defaults for those because they are the site's own facts.

author.description: Front matter key read by the theme's templates.

backlinks.description: Static backlinks: list the pages that link here, between the page annotation and the pager. Derived from ordinary Markdown links and ref/relref at build time; no runtime. Pages override with the front matter key `backlinks`.

blog_index.description: Form of the blog section list pages: list (rows), cards (a grid), or table (one compact row per post -- the whole section at once, no year groups, no pagination). Front matter `blog_index` (on the blog root, or through its cascade) overrides it per section.

blog_index_columns.description: Front matter key read by the theme's templates.

blog_index_size.description: Posts per page on a list or cards blog index; the table form always shows everything. Hugo ignores `pagination` set by a theme, so the list template passes this to .Paginate itself. Twelve divides by two, three, and four, so no card row is left short.

blog_index_toggle.description: Let a reader cycle the index through list, cards, and table from the index toolbar. Off by default: it puts every form in the document. The hidden ones load no images, but their markup is real.

body_class.description: Front matter key read by the theme's templates.

book_draft_banner.description: Draft state is always labeled in the sidebar; this optional banner adds an explicit notice at the start of draft book pages.

code_copy.description: Copy control on code blocks. `false` sets the site-wide default only; a fence that names `copy` explicitly still wins.

comments.description: `comments: false` is the boolean shorthand for this map.

description.description: Front matter key read by the theme's templates.

featured_image.description: How a blog page presents the featured image `images` selects: none | banner (a framed figure above the title) | wash (the image behind the article header at a low opacity) | hero (the immersive presentation: the blog shell paints the image as its own full-bleed backdrop and moves the opening down — on single pages and section indexes alike). Front matter `featured_image` overrides it for one page or, in a cascade, one section. A page that carries no image renders nothing either way.

feedback.description: One-click structured docs feedback. The theme calls the site's existing gtag integration when present; no endpoint or free-text form is used.

share.description: Page-end share bar: a list drawn from x | bluesky | mastodon | facebook | linkedin | reddit | hackernews | telegram | whatsapp | line | pinterest | weibo | chatgpt | claude | email | copy. Empty means no bar. Every entry is a plain link (or the local copy button), never a platform script or a share count. Discord publishes no share-intent URL, so `copy` stands in for it. Front matter `share: [x, copy]` replaces the list for one page and `share: false` turns its bar off; a section cascade scopes the bar to, say, the blog.

theme_color.description: Optional accent recolor: a `#rgb`/`#rrggbb` hex tints the shell's accent grounds -- the selected sidebar row, hover washes, the outline pill and its travelling rail, tag hovers, text selection, focus rings, and each root's mark in the sidebar switcher. It deliberately does NOT touch links or inline code, which stay the brand palette so running text reads the same in every section. Front matter `theme_color` overrides it per page, and a section root's `cascade` gives a whole section its own identity. `theme_color_dark` carries the dark palette; when omitted it is derived by lightening the light color until it reads AA on the dark canvas. Blank keeps the brand navy, and an invalid value warns and keeps it too; front matter `theme_color: false` opts a page out of an inherited color entirely.

theme_color_dark.description: Front matter key read by the theme's templates.

toc_style.description: Presentation of the right rail: fixed (a panel pinned to the viewport) or flow (a wider panel in the content flow that starts where the article starts and pins only on scroll — the immersive blog rail).

toc_taxonomies.description: Taxonomy term clouds on the right rail. Front matter `toc_taxonomies` (or a section cascade) turns them off; a rail left with neither a TOC nor clouds renders nothing at all.

translation_notice.description: Language code of the authoritative version, so a translated page can say so and link to it; false disables the line. Front matter `translation_notice: false` opts out a page written natively in this language.
